en.headline: Police to hold highest-honour funeral for PC Jacky Chu on 22 October
en.dek: The officer, who was left paralysed after a 2005 knife attack while on duty, will be buried at Gallant Garden the following day.
body: Sources said the Hong Kong Police Force will hold a highest-honour ceremonial funeral for Police Constable Jacky Chu Chun-kwok on 22 October at the World Funeral Parlour in Hung Hom, followed by burial at Gallant Garden on 23 October.

The rites will incorporate Chinese-style marching protocol and Taoist ceremony. Chu, who was awarded the Gold Medal for Bravery in 2006, died of organ failure on 16 September at Kwong Wah Hospital at the age of 52 after 21 years as a bedridden patient.

In July 2005, while conducting a stop-and-search in Cheung Sha Wan, Chu was stabbed in the neck. Despite heavy bleeding he continued to pursue the attacker before collapsing; the injury left him with hypoxic brain damage and total paralysis.

The Junior Police Officers’ Association had urged the force to accord the highest level of honours and interment at Gallant Garden, the dedicated resting place for public servants who die or are permanently disabled in the line of duty. Police earlier confirmed they would provide full support to the family.

zh.headline: 警方10月22日為警員朱振國舉行最高榮譽葬禮
zh.dek: 2005年執勤遇襲癱瘓21年的警員朱振國，將於翌日安葬浩園。
body: 消息指，香港警務處將於10月22日在九龍紅磡世界殯儀館為已故警員朱振國舉行最高榮譽儀式葬禮，翌日（23日）安葬浩園，採用中式步操禮儀及道教儀式。
朱振國於2006年獲頒授金英勇勳章，本月16日因器官衰竭在廣華醫院離世，終年52歲，臥牀21年。
2005年7月，朱振國在長沙灣執行截查任務時遭青年以刀割傷頸部大動脈，他負傷追捕後因失血過多導致腦缺氧，全身癱瘓。
警察隊員佐級協會早前爭取為朱振國安排最高榮譽喪禮及安葬浩園。浩園用作安葬因公殉職或永久傷殘的公務員。警方早前表示會向家屬提供一切適切協助。
